title: Senior AI Engineer
description: Role summaryThe Senior AI Engineer leads the design, build and operation of the machine learning models, large language model (LLM) services and agentic systems that drive Kaplan’s AI strategy. Your remit spans learner-facing products and internal AI-first business processes. You will be a technical reference point for the AI Engineering team, owning the design of the systems you build and helping set the standard for how we deliver reliable, secure and scalable AI services.As the Senior AI Engineer, you will:Lead the design, development and delivery of machine learning, LLM and agentic solutions for learner products and internal business workflows.Architect agentic workflows, including tool use, structured outputs, multi-agent orchestration and human-in-the-loop patterns.Champion engineering standards and best practice, and review the designs and code of other engineers.Own the reliability, cost, security and performance of AI services in production.Build and maintain evaluation tooling and observability for models and LLM-based systems.Mentor AI Engineers and help grow our engineering capability.Collaborate with teams across Kaplan, including product, data science, design and learning teams, to translate requirements into technical direction.Stay current with new AI tools and techniques and set direction on their practical adoption.Detailed responsibilitiesTechnical leadership and mentoringSet and champion standards for engineering quality, code review and reusable patterns.Lead the technical approach on ambiguous or novel problems.Own the design of the systems you build and shape architectural decisions across the AI platform, aligned with enterprise architecture.Mentor and develop AI Engineers through review, pairing and technical guidance.Model and agent developmentLead algorithm and framework selection, and design retrieval and grounding strategies, prompts and embeddings.Design, build and evaluate agentic workflows using frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework.Evaluate models and LLM-based systems using agreed metrics and methods, including golden datasets, LLM-as-judge evaluation, and tracing and observability tooling.Partner with data science colleagues, who own modelling and evaluation methodology, while you own production systems and evaluation tooling.Data managementWork with data teams to source, clean and version training and retrieval data.Ensure data handling meets GDPR and Kaplan’s privacy policies.Deployment and MLOpsOwn containerised deployment (Docker/Kubernetes) to cloud platforms.Lead automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, monitoring and alerting.Manage the capacity, cost and performance of AI services in production.Collaboration and supportProvide technical guidance to product, learning and content teams.Lead the resolution of production issues and their root causes.Act as a technical consultant to business stakeholders on AI-first workflow redesign.Innovation and growthAssess emerging techniques and paradigms and set direction on their practical adoption.Champion new ideas by building prototypes and translating research into tangible solutions.Share findings with product and learning stakeholders with clear impact statements.You’ll also carry out other duties, within the broad scope and spirit of your role, as requested by your manager. Our business continuously evolves, so your role will too.What you might be doing nowYour current role, or recent roles, may be:AI Engineer at Kaplan, ready to step upSenior Machine Learning EngineerSenior Software Engineer leading AI featuresMachine Learning Engineer leading the delivery of LLM or agentic systemsWhat you’ll bring to the roleThis role suits an experienced, pragmatic engineer who leads by example: someone who balances rapid experimentation with production-level rigour and raises the standard of those around them.You will have:5+ years’ experience in software or machine learning engineering.Substantial experience (typically 2+ years) building and operating LLM-based or agentic systems in production.Strong Python skills and knowledge of ML libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn).Experience with agent and LLM frameworks (e.g. Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph) and prompt engineering.Strong MLOps experience: CI/CD, container orchestration and infrastructure-as-code, with cloud platforms (Azure preferred).Knowledge of NoSQL/document databases (e.g. Azure Cosmos DB) and vector search (e.g. Azure AI Search), plus a solid grounding in relational/SQL database design and querying.Experience leading technical decisions, mentoring engineers and reviewing designs and code.A strong understanding of data privacy, security and responsible AI, and the ability to explain complex ideas to non-specialists.DesirableExperience with Google’s agent platform (Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform/Vertex AI, including the Agent Development Kit).Familiarity with agent interoperability standards such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent2Agent (A2A).Additional programming languages such as C# and the .NET framework.Experience with education-specific standards such as xAPI, LTI or LMS plug-ins. title: AI Solution Developer
description: Zensai’s AI Office leads the company’s AI Roadmap, focusing on high-impact, cross-functional initiatives that solve shared business challenges and create value across Zensai.As our AI Solution Developer, you will turn the priorities in our AI Roadmap into reliable, well-designed solutions that people actually use. You will work directly with teams across the business to understand their needs, design the right solution, build and refine it, and take it all the way into production and adoption.The AI Office is led by Maria, our VP of AI Office. You will work closely with the rest of the team and take ownership of AI projects from design and development through to successful implementation.One of your first projects could involve connecting customer emails, calls and support interactions to help our commercial teams identify customer risks, sentiment and growth opportunities earlier. Other projects will involve AI agents, intelligent workflows, internal tools and integrations across our business systems.What you’ll be doingWork directly with teams across Zensai to understand how they operate, uncover the real problem and define what a useful outcome looks likeDesign, build and deploy AI agents, AI-assisted workflows and intelligent automation solutions across the Microsoft ecosystemConnect systems and data through APIs, Model Context Protocol, integrations and data transformationsDecide where AI creates value, where deterministic logic is more appropriate and how to balance technical possibilities with business needsMonitor solutions after deployment, handling failures, performance, cost and continuous improvement to keep them reliable and useful This is not a role focused primarily on model experimentation or AI research. It is for someone who enjoys solving business problems and building solutions that work reliably in production.What you bringExperience building and deploying software solutions that solve real business problems, with confidence working in PythonHands-on experience with large language models, AI-powered workflows, agent-based solutions and intelligent automationExperience connecting systems through APIs, Model Context Protocol, integrations and data transformationSolid hands-on experience within the Microsoft ecosystem, particularly Azure, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, Microsoft Foundry or Foundry IQStrong business understanding and clear communication: you can turn messy problems into practical solutions, explain complex technology to non-technical colleagues and take ownership through to production Meet the AI OfficeThe AI Office works across Zensai and sits close to our CEO, reflecting the importance of AI to the company’s direction. The team brings together technical development, business enablement and implementation to help promising ideas become solutions that deliver real results. We are still establishing some of our processes and ways of working. You will have experienced colleagues to collaborate with and challenge, while also having the freedom to structure your own projects and influence how the team delivers solutions.The team is based across Copenhagen and Aarhus. This role is based in Copenhagen, with occasional travel to Aarhus so we can work and spend time together as one team.ProcessApply in just a few minutes, no cover letter required. We review applications weekly and keep you updated throughout the process. Learn more about how we hire at Zensai here!The benefits!Full Flexibility: Work where and when you do your best! Morning person or night owl? Home office or office vibes? You decide.Learning: 10% of your working time dedicated to development. Built in, not squeezed in.Pension & Health: We’ve got you covered—literally. Enjoy a robust pension plan that includes life insurance, and coverage if life throws a curveball like loss of work capacity or serious illness. Plus, our health insurance takes care of hospital stays, surgeries, physical therapy—you name it. Peace of mind, sorted.Laptop & Company Phone: Stay connected with a Laptop & iPhone on us. Need a subscription? We’ve got that too.Lunch & Snacks: Feels more like fine dining when we go to lunch, including tasty meals, snacks, and drinks. Your taste buds will thank you!About ZensaiZensai is a global team of around 200 people across Europe, the US, and ANZ. We believe people should have the opportunity to keep learning, feel connected to their workplace, and do their best work. That’s why we created the Human Success Platform. Built into Microsoft 365 and powered by AI, it helps companies turn learning, engagement, and performance into a natural part of everyday work. Show more Show less

title: Principal Research Scientist – Multimodal Reasoning & Embodied AI
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.Here’s what this particular role covers.🛠️ About Our Labs TeamWayve Labs develops the next generation of learning capabilities for embodied AI, using autonomous driving as a demanding real-world testbed. Within FORGE, our Language & Reasoning team explores how LLMs, VLMs and VLAs can connect world knowledge, grounded reasoning, memory and planning to physical action. We work across model architectures, training and post-training, with the goal of helping driving agents generalise to new environments, follow goals and constraints, and handle rare situations. The team collaborates across London and Sunnyvale, with opportunities to publish fundamental research.🧠 Your day-to-dayYou will set and lead an ambitious research agenda at the intersection of LLMs, VLMs, VLAs and embodied AI, asking how agents can use world knowledge, visual understanding, memory and reasoning to make better decisions in the physical world.You will remain hands-on: developing new architectures and learning methods, training and evaluating large-scale models, and testing whether better reasoning leads to better behaviour in challenging driving scenarios.As a Principal Research Scientist, you will guide the technical direction of the team, mentor researchers, build strong collaborations with Engineering, and turn original ideas into rigorous evidence, influential publications and capabilities that shape Wayve's next generation of AI.🧩 What You’ll Be Working OnAdvance multimodal foundation models: Research and develop LLMs, VLMs and VLAs that integrate visual understanding, language, reasoning and action for embodied decision-making.Develop reasoning and planning capabilities: Explore structured and latent reasoning, long-horizon planning, temporal understanding, memory, self-reflection and test-time computation for physically grounded agents.Push the boundaries of model training: Develop scalable training and post-training methods, including supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, reward modelling, distillation and learning from human or AI-generated feedback.Build steerable and adaptable policies: Enable embodied agents to understand instructions, follow goals and preferences, reason about constraints and generalise to novel environments and situations.Explore agentic and hierarchical architectures: Investigate how deliberative reasoning, memory, external tools and fast reactive policies can work together, balancing intelligence, reliability and real-time constraints.Bridge reasoning and action: Develop approaches that turn semantic understanding and reasoning into meaningful improvements in physical-world behaviour, rather than treating language generation as an end in itself.Drive research from idea to evidence: Design rigorous experiments, build prototypes, establish challenging evaluations and demonstrate improvements in real-world capabilities.Shape the research direction: Work closely with researchers across foundation models, representation learning, world modelling and reinforcement learning. Contribute original ideas, mentor others and help define the next generation of embodied AI systems.🙌 You Should Apply IfA strong research track record in deep learning, particularly in one or more of LLMs, VLMs, VLAs, multimodal foundation models or embodied AI.Deep technical understanding of modern foundation model architectures, transformer-based models, multimodal representation learning and generative modelling.Hands-on experience developing, training, fine-tuning or post-training large-scale models, with a solid understanding of the challenges involved.Strong knowledge of modern learning methods, such as instruction tuning, reinforcement learning, preference optimisation, reward modelling or reasoning-oriented post-training.Excellent understanding of machine learning fundamentals, combined with the ability to challenge existing approaches and develop novel research ideas.Strong practical skills in Python, PyTorch and large-scale machine learning experimentation.Demonstrated ability to independently lead ambitious research projects, from identifying important problems to developing solutions and validating their impact.A PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Robotics or a related field, or equivalent research experience, with a strong publication record or evidence of impactful research contributions.🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.More About Wayve🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.🔍 The Interview ProcessOur process is clear and respectful of your time:Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)Competency Interviews (Hiring Manager interview; 1 hour)Deep-dive technical interviews ( PyTorch debugging, ML Breadth, ML Research, ML System Design; 3 hours total)Final interview: Mission & values alignment (Director / VP interview; 45 minutes)We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.What’s in it for you (Location dependant):💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and moreA quick, honest note before you apply.Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at WayveDISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.Compensation Range: $407,330 - $460,020 Show more Show less
